artifacts.summary: lake exe check_certificate: shared tag-format JSON parser, runtime WitnessFamily decoding, four-instance verdict with failure localization, executable root, 21 acceptance rows, wire schema in BimodalTools/README.md.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added lake exe check_certificate: it reads a witness-family certificate as JSON on stdin, rebuilds the dependently-typed WitnessFamily at runtime via dite on every proof field, runs the four Decidable instances joint_countermodel consumes, and prints one JSON line that is either countermodel or rejected naming the failed condition, lasso and position. Along the way the tag-format JSON parser was extracted into BimodalTools/JsonParse.lean, removing one of two duplicates; one new theorem, mem_closureList, closes the computable-closure-enumeration obligation. All seven phases complete, every gate green, measured at 61-62 ms on a certificate of total segment length 101.
